   Sub.: Audio recording of earnings call – Q2FY2027 – Unaudited Financial Results

Analysts to be hosted by the Company on Monday, October 12, 2026 at 11.00 am (IST) to discuss the 
Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
